FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.q1: How do I start processing my Bill of Lading?
FAQ.a1: Enter your Bill of Lading number, email address, and category to receive an access link via email.
FAQ.q2: How do I make a payment via PayMaya?
FAQ.a2: If payment is required, you will be redirected to PayMaya after clicking the link in your email to pay ₱165 securely.
FAQ.q3: What happens after I upload my documents?
FAQ.a3: You will receive an email update — if approved, you’ll get your CRO and receipts. If rejected, you’ll get a link to re-upload only the rejected files.
FAQ.a4: Absolutely. We use email-based authentication and strict access controls to keep your information safe.
